subject: Literature
title: Poetry in Times of Crisis
description: A quick win: understand Poetry in Times of Crisis.

hook.text: After September 11, people taped poems to lampposts and subway walls across New York City.

buildup.text: In every crisis, from pandemics to wars, poetry circulates faster than any other literary form.

discovery.text: During COVID-19 lockdowns, poetry readings on Zoom and social media saw audiences larger than pre-pandemic events.

twist.text: Scientists studying grief found that reading poetry activates brain regions associated with emotional processing.

climax.text: Poetry endures because in moments of extremity, it says what prose cannot: the unsayable, compressed into rhythm.

punchline.text: When the world breaks, people reach for poems first.

quiz.question: What did scientists discover about poetry's effect on the brain?
options: It has no measurable neurological effect
Reading poetry activates brain regions associated with emotional processing
It only stimulates the language center, not emotional areas
